requirements.requirement: The system must accept raw prescription behavior input conforming to the data contract defined in EVAL-P-RX-UX-S1.
The system must transform raw prescription records into a normalized internal structure for frontend consumption.
The system must rank drugs by relevance using logic defined in design/design_eval_p_rx_drug_mapping.
The system must select a top-N subset of drugs for display based on ranked relevance.
The system must compute a single relevance indicator value from the ranked drug set.
The system must map backend integrity flags to UI states of either "clean" or "flagged".
The system must include score contribution data in the transformed output if present in the input.
The system must output a structure that exactly matches the UI contract defined in EVAL-P-RX-UX-S1.
The system must ensure deterministic transformation results for identical input data.
The system must handle empty drug lists by returning an output structure with no top drugs and a null or default relevance indicator.
The system must handle missing or undefined integrity flags by defaulting the UI state to "flagged".
The system must ignore malformed drug entries that do not meet minimum schema requirements during transformation.
The system must preserve drug identifiers and names exactly as received when constructing the display-ready structure.
The system must compute relevance indicator within acceptable bounds defined by the design (e.g., normalized scale).
